title: AI-generated Treatment Recommendations in Precision Oncology
official: Eine Nichtunterlegenheitsstudie zu KI-generierten, Personalisierten Therapieempfehlungen für Die Präzisionsmedizin (AI-PRIME)
summary: Non-interventional study to assess the non-inferiority of AI-generated treatment recommendations for precision oncology. Molecular tumor profiles will be assessed by local AI models to identify treatment options. Resulting treatment options will then be compared with actual personalized therapy recommendations.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* advanced solid tumor
* \>=18years
* ECOG 0-1
* comprehensive molecular tumor analysis planned

Exclusion Criteria:

* lack of capacity to consent
* hematological neoplasm
